roles.tooltip.admin.users.view: Allows viewing the full member list in the admin console, including usernames, roles, status, and basic profile info. Required to access the member management tab.
roles.tooltip.admin.users.edit: Allows editing other members' profiles, including power, classes, title, bio, vacation status, and admin notes.
roles.tooltip.admin.users.role: Allows changing a member's assigned role (e.g. promoting a member to moderator). Roles determine what permissions the user has. All changes are logged in the audit trail.
roles.tooltip.admin.users.activate: Allows activating or deactivating member accounts. Deactivated members cannot log in but their data is preserved.
roles.tooltip.admin.users.delete: Allows deactivating member accounts and hiding them from member lists. Their data is retained.
roles.tooltip.admin.users.password: Allows resetting another member's password. A temporary password is generated and must be communicated to the member.
roles.tooltip.admin.invite.view: Allows viewing all invite links, including codes, usage counts, expiry dates, and current status.
roles.tooltip.admin.invite.manage: Allows creating new invite links and revoking existing ones. Revoked links immediately stop accepting new registrations.
roles.tooltip.admin.audit.view: Allows viewing the system audit log, which records all operations such as member changes, event creation, and permission modifications.
roles.tooltip.admin.audit.export: Allows exporting audit logs as CSV or JSON files for external analysis or archival.
roles.tooltip.admin.status.view: Allows viewing system health status, including database, R2 storage, WebSocket, and cron job health checks.
roles.tooltip.admin.roles.view: Allows viewing all roles and their permission configurations, but does not allow making changes.
roles.tooltip.admin.roles.manage: Allows creating, deleting, and configuring roles, including modifying permission assignments for each role. This is the highest-level admin permission — grant with caution.
roles.tooltip.admin.siteConfig.manage: Allows editing guild branding. Changes are logged in the audit trail.
roles.tooltip.admin.classes.manage: Allows creating and styling classes, selecting vector icons, and managing custom class icon uploads.
roles.tooltip.admin.analytics.view: Allows viewing the analytics dashboard, including member activity, event participation rates, and other statistics.
roles.tooltip.admin.analytics.manage: Allows modifying analytics configuration, such as reporting periods and metric types.
roles.tooltip.guildwar.teams.edit: Allows editing guild war team compositions, including creating teams, assigning members to teams, and setting team names.
roles.tooltip.guildwar.history.edit: Allows editing guild war history records, including recording match results, adding battle notes, and updating individual member stats.
roles.tooltip.events.create: Allows creating new events (raids, guild wars, social gatherings, etc.) with configurable time, capacity, and description.
roles.tooltip.events.edit: Allows editing existing event details, including title, description, time, capacity, and pinned status.
roles.tooltip.events.archive: Allows archiving completed events. Archived events remain viewable but no longer accept signups.
roles.tooltip.events.delete: Allows permanently deleting events and all associated signup records. This action cannot be undone.
roles.tooltip.events.templates: Allows managing recurring event templates, including creating, editing, pausing, and deleting periodic event schedules.
roles.tooltip.announcements.create: Allows creating new announcements. They can be published immediately, scheduled for later, or saved as drafts.
roles.tooltip.announcements.edit: Allows editing existing announcements, including title, content, pinned status, and publish time.
roles.tooltip.announcements.archive: Allows archiving announcements. Archived announcements no longer appear on the homepage but remain accessible in the archive.
roles.tooltip.announcements.delete: Allows permanently deleting announcements. This action cannot be undone.
roles.tooltip.gallery.upload: Allows uploading images to the gallery. All members have this permission by default.
roles.tooltip.gallery.manage: Allows managing gallery content, including editing image titles, captions, and metadata.
roles.tooltip.gallery.delete: Allows deleting images or videos from the gallery. This action cannot be undone.
roles.tooltip.wiki.articles.create: Allows creating new wiki articles, selecting a category, and editing rich-text content.
roles.tooltip.wiki.articles.edit: Allows editing existing wiki article content, titles, and category assignments.
roles.tooltip.wiki.articles.archive: Allows archiving wiki articles. Archived articles are hidden from the table of contents but remain accessible via direct link.
roles.tooltip.wiki.articles.delete: Allows permanently deleting wiki articles. This action cannot be undone.
roles.tooltip.wiki.categories.manage: Allows managing the wiki category structure, including creating, renaming, reordering, and deleting categories. Categories must be empty before deletion.
roles.tooltip.admin.storage.structure: Allows creating, renaming, reordering, and deleting storage locations and categories.
roles.tooltip.admin.storage.items: Allows creating and editing storage item records, including names, descriptions, categories, and item images.
roles.tooltip.admin.storage.stock: Allows changing storage item quantities through intake, distribution, and stock adjustment operations.
